name: lambda_composition.k
model:
f:Array[Int, Int]

g:Array[Int, Int]

req f[0] = 1

req f[5] = 6

req f[10] = 11

req g[0] = 0

req g[1] = 2

req g[6] = 12

x:Int

req x = 5

req g[f[x]] = 12
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (f (Array Int Int))(g (Array Int Int))(x Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.f: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!f ((this Ref)) (Array Int Int)
  (f (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.g: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!g ((this Ref)) (Array Int Int)
  (g (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.x: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (TopLevelDeclarations!f this) 0) 1)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (TopLevelDeclarations!f this) 5) 6)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (TopLevelDeclarations!f this) 10) 11)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (TopLevelDeclarations!g this) 0) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (TopLevelDeclarations!g this) 1) 2)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (TopLevelDeclarations!g this) 6) 12)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 0) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 7: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!x this) 5)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv7 0) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 8: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv8 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (TopLevelDeclarations!g this) (select (TopLevelDeclarations!f this) (TopLevelDeclarations!x this))) 12)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv8 0) :named _xkassert7))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (let ((a!1 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 4) 0 1) 5 6) 10 11))
      (a!2 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 2) 0 0) 3 7) 6 12)))
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations a!1 a!2 5)))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (f (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))
                   (x (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
(let ((a!2 (select (g (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) a!1)))
  (= a!2 12))))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (f (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) 10)))
  (= a!1 11)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (g (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) 0)))
  (= a!1 0)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (g (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) 6)))
  (= a!1 12)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (f (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) 0)))
  (= a!1 1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (f (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) 5)))
  (= a!1 6)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (g (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) 1)))
  (= a!1 2)))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (= (x (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) 5))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 4) 0 1) 5 6) 10 11))
      (a!2 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 2) 0 0) 3 7) 6 12)))
  (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
         0
         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations a!1 a!2 5)))))
